metadataRaw.description:
Are you noticing new aches, pain, and stiffness in your back due to working from home?

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows the best work from home achy back exercises to help give QUICK RELIEF!

The exercises will be broken up to tackle different areas of the back, pretty much from the upper back all the way down to the lower back, hips, and pelvis.

Go through all of the exercises to get the best results, and take what works best for your back pain, aches, and tightness.

As a bonus, all of these exercises will require NO EQUIPMENT, and may give fast back pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:50 Full Back Exercise
3:30 Figure 8 (Upper Back)
5:55 Seated Figure 4 (Lower Back & Hips)
8:08 Pelvis and SI Joint Release
9:38 Tight Leg Muscle Fix
